result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so your Anna/Bob example hasn't been run.

In `DataStore.java` I added a second constant to the `CustomerAttributedRecords` enum, `ACTIVE_PURCHASE_ORDERS`. It is the same as `PURCHASE_ORDERS` but adds `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` now uses it, which gives the new counts. Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I left the existing `PURCHASE_ORDERS` constant as it was, because the per-country purchase-order report also uses it. The task only mentions the per-rep report, so the per-country report still counts cancelled orders. Switching it to the new constant would be a one-line change, if you want it consistent.
